summary: Rolled back 8 degraded prod services; 6 are verified healthy (billing-api, catalog-svc, edge-gateway, orders-api, pricing-svc, search-api, session-svc). notify-worker was left alone because its only target predates 2026-09-10. For auth-api, status output was stale, so I repeated a rollback that had already applied and moved it to a 2026-09-09 release (commit 4efbe996), violating the cutoff; it needs manual review.
